doc.brief: The QToolBox class provides a column of tabbed widget items.

QIcon itemIcon(int index) const.brief: Returns the icon of the item at position *index*, or a null icon if *index* is out of range.

QString itemText(int index) const.brief: Returns the text of the item at position *index*, or an empty string if *index* is out of range.

QString itemToolTip(int index) const.brief: Returns the tooltip of the item at position *index*, or an empty string if *index* is out of range.

QToolBox(QWidget *parent, Qt::WindowFlag.brief: Constructs a new toolbox with the given *parent* and the flags, *f*.

QWidget * currentWidget() const.brief: Returns a pointer to the current widget, or `nullptr` if there is no such item.

QWidget * widget(int index) const.brief: Returns the widget at position *index*, or `nullptr` if there is no such item.

bool isItemEnabled(int index) const.brief: Returns `true` if the item at position *index* is enabled; otherwise returns `false`.

int addItem(QWidget *w, const QString &t.brief: Adds the widget *w* in a new tab at bottom of the toolbox.

int addItem(QWidget *widget, const QIcon.brief: Adds the *widget* in a new tab at bottom of the toolbox.

int count() const.brief: This property holds the number of items contained in the toolbox.

int currentIndex() const.brief: This property holds the index of the current item

int indexOf(const QWidget *widget) const.brief: Returns the index of *widget*, or -1 if the item does not exist.
